title: Dil Hai Betab
desc: A middle-class girl falls in love with her college friend, and the couple wish to marry, then her father says that he has received a marriage proposal for her from a rich man that they cannot refuse.

title: Suhana Safar
desc: Enticed by his poetry, Sapna travels to India from the USA to meet poet Ujjwala. She meets a man, Sunil, who falls for her but decides to help her reach him in Phulwari.

title: Babu
desc: Babu is a naive young man who likes to go out of his way to help people. He has fallen in love with Kammo, but in the process of helping another, he lands himself in jail for two years. After his discharge, he finds that a lady who had once helped him, is now a destitute widow with a small child, Pinky.

title: Kaash
desc: Following a serious box office flop, movie star-turned-producer Ritesh (Jackie Shroff) and his wife, Pooja (Dimple Kapadia), are forced to downgrade to a simpler lifestyle. This leads to the husband becoming an alcoholic, the wife taking a menial job as a chambermaid, and their young child being forced to watch as his parents' relationship disintegrates. Ritesh and Pooja are living apart when their son is diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, which leads to a bittersweet reunion for all three.

title: Nirbhay
desc: After a mother abandons her child and leaves him in an orphanage, he is falsely accused of two murders and faces jail term. After he walks out of prison, he seeks revenge from the culprits.
